Name: gof_survival_attribution
Title: Why Does GOF Survive Family-Split? Embedding Dimension Attribution for Cross-Family GOF Signal
Experiment: GOF AUROC under family-split (0.63-0.73) is the one robust class-level signal. This experiment asks: which of the 1280 ESM-2 embedding dimensions carry that signal? Train a sparse logistic regression (L1-penalized) on GOF-vs-rest in delta_mean space under family-split CV. Extract the non-zero weight dimensions. Compare the top-N dimensions between gene-split and family-split GOF probes — dimensions present in family-split but absent in gene-split are candidates for genuine cross-family GOF signal. Cross-reference top dimensions with known ESM-2 feature analyses (e.g. Lin et al. 2023 contact map dimensions). Report: how many dimensions carry the family-split GOF signal, and do they cluster in specific ESM-2 layer ranges?

Name: mechanism_floor_per_class_breakdown
Title: Decomposing the ~0.36 Family-Split Floor: How Much Signal Survives Per Class and Per Dataset Subset?
Experiment: The family-split macro-F1 floor of ~0.35-0.39 is an average. Decompose it: (1) per-class AUROC under family-split across all existing results (GOF/DN/LOF), (2) stratify by gene-family size — do genes in larger Pfam families show higher or lower mechanism signal under family-split? (3) bootstrap CI (n=500, gene-level resampling) on the family-split GOF AUROC to confirm it is distinguishable from 0.5. The key question: is the floor driven by GOF alone, or do DN and LOF contribute non-trivially?

Name: pathogenicity_mechanism_joint_embedding
Title: Joint Pathogenicity-Mechanism Embedding: Does Orthogonalising Against Pathogenicity Expose Mechanism Signal?
Experiment: Pathogenicity is strongly encoded in delta space (AUROC 0.88). Mechanism is weakly encoded (floor ~0.36). These are the same embedding — so mechanism must be orthogonal to or correlated with the pathogenicity direction. Test: (1) fit a pathogenicity LDA direction on the ClinVar pathogenic/benign embeddings (already cached); (2) project out this direction from delta_mean; (3) re-run MLP mechanism probe under family-split CV on the residual. If mechanism AUROC increases after pathogenicity projection, the two signals are entangled and the pathogenicity axis was masking mechanism. If AUROC is unchanged or decreases, mechanism and pathogenicity occupy independent subspaces. Compare to the FoldX ΔΔG projection already run (which showed no change). This is the first experiment to test whether the pathogenicity signal is the dominant noise axis for mechanism.
